|begin=[[34 ABY]]<ref name="DateNote">''[[Resistance Reborn]]'' is set after the [[First Order]] has [[Conquest of Corellia|taken control]] of [[Corellia]], which is depicted in [[Legacy of Vader 6|''Legacy of Vader'' 6]]. Therefore, ''Legacy of Vader'' 6 must be set before ''Resistance Reborn''. Furthermore, ''Legacy of Vader'' 6 is set after [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. As both ''The Last Jedi'' and ''Resistance Reborn'' are dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', the events of the ''Legacy of Vader'' 6, including the conquest of Corellia and the ensuing beginning of the planet's occupation, must occur in the same [[Standard year|year]]. Furthermore, ''Resistance Reborn'' says that most [[Corellian]]s "eventually" accepted the occupation. As there is only a short [[time]] between ''The Last Jedi'' and ''Resistance Reborn'' according to the latter's narrative, with an even shorter time therefore occurring between ''Legacy of Vader'' and its events, this "eventually" time frame must have been quick.</ref>

During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], [[Corellia]] was subject to an '''occupation'''<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> after it was [[Conquest of Corellia|conquered]] by the [[First Order]], which wanted to claim the planet, its [[shipyard]]s, and its [[Factory|factories]]<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="DateNote" /> Most [[Corellian]]s displayed scorn at being subject to the occupation but<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> quickly<ref name="DateNote" /> accepted the new reality. The First Order at some point had also annexed control over the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="Resistance Reborn" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the "[[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]]." As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Starkiller Incident to [[34 ABY]], it can be deduced the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> after the First Order joined with the [[Sith Eternal]] and its [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], and were defeated in the [[Battle of Exegol]], Corellia was in [[Uprising on Corellia|open rebellion]] against the First Order.<ref name="TROS Junior Novel">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref>
